author: Linsey Lewis
title: Man wanted for Washington double murder has ties to Las Vegas - NewsBreak
text:
By Linsey Lewis No media credit provided. ,
2 hours ago LAS VEGAS (KLAS) — A man wanted for his alleged involvement in the murders of two women and the attempted murder of another in Washington has ties to Las Vegas, according to the Federal Bureau of Investigation.
On May 21, 2023, Samuel Ramirez Jr., was allegedly involved in a shooting that left two women dead and a third person injured at the Stars Bar and Grill in Federal Way, Washington, the FBI said.
>>Download the 8 News Now Vegas streaming app After the shooting, Ramirez Jr. fled to Lake Havasu City, Arizona and was driven to Tijuana, Mexico by his parents on May 23, 2023, according to the FBI.
Ramirez Jr. was charged with murder in the second degree, murder in the first degree and attempted murder in the first degree. The King County Superior County, State of Washington, issued an arrest warrant for Ramirez Jr. on May 24, 2023.
Samuel Ramirez Jr. wanted for his alleged involvement in the murders of two women and the attempted murder of another in Washington. Photo taken in 2023. (FBI) Samuel Ramirez Jr. wanted for his alleged involvement in the murders of two women and the attempted murder of another in Washington. (FBI) Samuel Ramirez Jr. tattoo on his right wrist and forearm (FBI) On Nov. 14, 2025, a federal arrest warrant was issued for Ramirez Jr. in the U.S. District Court, Western District of Washington after he was charged with unlawful flight to avoid prosecution.
Ramirez Jr. has ties to Lake Havasu City, Arizona; Compton, California; Las Vegas; and Jalisco and Sinaloa, Mexico, the FBI said.
He should be considered armed and dangerous. Anyone with information concerning this case is asked to contact their local FBI office, the nearest American Embassy or Consulate, or submit a tip online HERE.
The FBI is offering a reward up to $25,000 for information leading to the location, arrest and conviction of Ramirez Jr.
